import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import subprocess
import urllib.request

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
bench = root / 'docs/benchmarks'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
desc = lambda p: {'path': str(Path(p).relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(p)}
read = lambda name: json.loads((bench / f'2026-10-16-handshake-inline-{name}.json').read_text())
meta = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/handshake-inline-candidate.json').read_text())
revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip()

def same_runtime(a, b):
    assert subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--quiet', a, b, '--', 'src', 'vendor', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock'], cwd=root).returncode == 0

same_runtime(meta['source_revision'], revision)
for name, digest in meta['sources'].items():
    assert sha(root / name) == sha(root / meta['directory'] / name) == digest
for name, digest in meta['binaries'].items():
    assert sha(root / 'target/release' / name) == sha(root / meta['directory'] / name) == digest
for snapshot in [meta['helper'], meta['allocator_driver'], meta['driver']]:
    for name, digest in snapshot['sources'].items():
        assert sha(root / snapshot['directory'] / name) == digest
for name, digest in meta['driver']['sources'].items():
    assert sha(root / name) == digest

def empty(m):
    for name in ['war_connections', 'war_sessions', 'war_queued_bytes', 'war_variable_bytes',
                 'war_output_queue_capacity_bytes', 'war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes']:
        assert int(m[name]) == 0, (name, m[name])
    assert int(m['war_channels']) == 1

def handshake(data, binary, profile=False):
    assert data['passed'] and data['server_sha256'] == binary and data['profile_diagnostic'] == profile
    assert data['server_exit_code'] == data['client_exit_code'] == 0
    assert not data.get('client_forced_kill') and not data.get('server_forced_kill')
    n = data['args']['connections']; recovered = min(n, 16)
    events = {e['event']: e for e in data['events']}
    assert set(events) == {'ready', 'dripped', 'expired', 'reused', 'measured', 'done'}
    assert events['ready']['metrics']['war_connections'] == events['dripped']['metrics']['war_connections'] == n + 1
    assert events['dripped']['metrics']['war_handshake_errors_total'] == 0
    assert data['sent_drip_bytes'] == n * (data['args']['rounds'] if data['args']['kind'] == 'drip' else 0)
    assert events['expired']['metrics']['war_connections'] == 1
    assert events['expired']['metrics']['war_handshake_errors_total'] == n
    assert events['expired']['metrics']['war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes'] <= data['args']['workers'] * 8192
    assert events['reused']['metrics']['war_connections'] == recovered + 1
    final = data['final']['metrics']; empty(final)
    assert all(final[k] == v for k, v in data['exact_checks'].items())
    assert final['war_accepted_total'] == n + recovered + 2 and final['war_rejected_total'] == 1
    assert final['war_handshake_errors_total'] == n + recovered
    assert final['war_routing_copied_bytes_total'] == 0
    assert data['healthy']['healthy']['verified'] == final['war_incoming_messages_total'] > 0
    assert data['management'] and all(0 <= item['latency_ms'] < 1000 for item in data['management'])
    if n:
        assert data['expiry_seconds']['first'] >= 4.85
        assert data['expiry_seconds']['last'] <= events['ready']['seconds'] + 7

comparison = read('comparison')
assert comparison['passed'] and len(comparison['cases']) == 48
assert comparison['candidate']['sources'] == meta['sources'] and comparison['candidate']['driver'] == meta['driver']
assert comparison['variants']['before']['sha256'] == meta['baseline']['sha256']
assert comparison['variants']['selected']['sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
for item in [*comparison['variants'].values(), comparison['client']]:
    assert sha(root / item['path']) == item['sha256']
for row in comparison['cases']:
    path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['sha256'] and row['exit_code'] == 0
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()); handshake(data, comparison['variants'][row['kind']]['sha256'])
    assert data['isolated_namespace'] and data['client_sha256'] == comparison['client']['sha256']
    assert data['args']['connections'] == row['connections'] and data['args']['workers'] == row['workers']
overlap = {}
for key, old in comparison['medians'].items():
    if key.endswith('/before'):
        a, b = old['ranges']['healthy'], comparison['medians'][key[:-6] + 'selected']['ranges']['healthy']
        overlap[key[:-7]] = max(a[0], b[0]) <= min(a[1], b[1])
assert len(overlap) == 8 and all(overlap.values())
memory = read('memory'); assert memory['passed'] and len(memory['cases']) == 4 and len(memory['captures']) == 24
assert memory['candidate']['sources'] == meta['sources']
assert memory['candidate']['driver'] == meta['allocator_driver']
for row in memory['cases']:
    path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['sha256']
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()); handshake(data, comparison['variants'][row['kind']]['sha256'], True)
    assert data['isolated_namespace'] and data['args']['quiet'] and data['args']['rounds'] == 32
for capture in memory['captures']:
    assert sha(root / capture['path']) == capture['sha256']
controls = [c for c in memory['cases'] if c['connections'] == 0]
assert controls[0]['drip_delta'] == controls[1]['drip_delta'] == {'live_objects': 0, 'live_bytes': 0, 'allocated_objects': 1650, 'allocated_bytes': 2057616}
old, new = [c for c in memory['cases'] if c['connections'] == 256]
assert (old['drip_delta']['allocated_objects'], new['drip_delta']['allocated_objects']) == (9843, 1652)
assert old['phases']['ready']['live_bytes'] - new['phases']['ready']['live_bytes'] == 73728
symbols = read('alloc-symbols'); assert symbols['passed'] and len(symbols['cases']) == 2
assert symbols['cases'][0]['drive_allocations'] == {'allocated_objects': 8192, 'allocated_bytes': 2359296}
assert symbols['cases'][1]['drive_allocations'] == {'allocated_objects': 0, 'allocated_bytes': 0}
for name, count in [('routing-guard', 12), ('burst-guard', 6)]:
    guard = read(name); assert guard['passed'] and len(guard['cases']) == count
    for row in guard['cases']:
        path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['trace_sha256']
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        assert data['passed'] and not data['profile_diagnostic'] and not data['server_forced_kill']
        assert data['server_exit_code'] == data['client_exit_code'] == 0
        assert data['server_sha256'] == comparison['variants'][row['kind']]['sha256']
        assert data['client_sha256'] == guard['client']['sha256']
        assert data['client_source_root'] == str(root / 'artifacts/baselines/fanout-probe')
        for event in data['events']:
            assert event['metrics']['war_routing_copied_bytes_total'] == 0
            assert event['metrics']['war_accept_errors_total'] == event['metrics']['war_setup_errors_total'] == 0
        empty(data['events'][-1]['metrics'])
    for path, digest in guard['client']['source_hashes'].items():
        assert sha(root / 'artifacts/baselines/fanout-probe' / path) == digest
ci = read('ci'); handshake(ci, sha(root / 'target/debug/war-relay'))
assert ci['client_sha256'] == sha(root / 'target/debug/examples/admission')
assert not any(ci['args'][key] for key in ['server_cpus', 'client_cpus', 'controller_cpus'])
upper = read('idle-upper'); handshake(upper, meta['binaries']['war-relay'])
assert upper['args']['connections'] == 8192 and upper['args']['kind'] == 'idle'
admission = read('admission-upper')
assert admission['passed'] and admission['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert admission['server_exit_code'] == admission['client_exit_code'] == 0
empty(admission['events'][-1]['metrics'])
fanout = read('fanout-upper')
assert fanout['passed'] and fanout['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert fanout['server_exit_code'] == fanout['client_exit_code'] == 0 and not fanout['server_forced_kill']
assert fanout['args']['fanout_readers'] == 1024 and fanout['mixed']['fanout_membership']['verified'] == 445
empty(fanout['events'][-1]['metrics'])
for workers in [1, 4]:
    stop = read(f'stop-w{workers}')
    assert stop['passed'] and stop['native_exit_code'] == 0 and stop['flood_exit_code'] == 1
    assert stop['shutdown_close'] == 1001 and stop['verified_echoes_during_flood'] == 8
stress = read('stability'); assert stress['passed'] and len(stress['cases']) == 4
assert stress['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
for case in stress['cases']:
    assert case['passed'] and case['server_exit_code'] == case['exit_code'] == 0 and not case['server_forced_kill']
    assert case['cleaned_up'] and case['counts_match'] and case['pressure_valid']; empty(case['final']['metrics'])
accept, setup = read('accept'), read('setup')
assert accept['passed'] and len(accept['cases']) == 3 and accept['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert accept['bridge_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-legacy-bridge']
for case in accept['cases']:
    assert case['passed'] and case['pressure']['fd_count'] == 64 and all(code == 0 for code in case['process_exit_codes'])
assert setup['passed'] and len(setup['cases']) == 4 and setup['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
for case in setup['cases']:
    assert case['passed'] and case['process_exit_code'] == 0 and len(case['injected_calls']) == 3
    assert all(wave['slot_held_until_descriptor_close'] for wave in case['waves'])
reference, api, browser = read('reference'), read('api'), read('browser')
assert reference['passed'] and reference['common_cases'] == 48
assert reference['upstream_commit'] == '881c8daaf2cf05adea8f522b28cf372e8f82d4e9'
assert len(reference['results']['cpp']['intentional_differences']) == len(reference['results']['rust']['intentional_differences']) == 8
for role, name in [('native', 'war-relay'), ('bridge', 'war-legacy-bridge')]:
    assert reference[role]['sha256'] == meta['binaries'][name] and reference[role]['exit_code'] == 0
    assert sha(f'/proc/{browser["runtime"][role]["pid"]}/exe') == browser['runtime'][role]['sha256'] == meta['binaries'][name]
assert api['passed'] and len(api['checks']) == 4 and api['server_exit_code'] == 0; empty(api['final_metrics'])
assert api['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert browser['passed'] and len(browser['browser']['checks']) == 7 and not browser['browser']['errors']
assert browser['worker_listener_sockets'] == 4 and all(status == 200 for status in browser['health'].values()); empty(browser['metrics'])
same_runtime(meta['source_revision'], browser['source_revision'])
assert 'Total messages: 0 (Errors: 0, Warnings: 0)' in (root / 'artifacts/handshake-inline-browser-console.txt').read_text()
verification = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/handshake-inline-verification.json').read_text())
assert verification['passed'] and len(verification['steps']) == 16
for step in verification['steps']:
    assert step['exit_code'] == 0 and sha(root / step['log']) == step['sha256']
tests = (root / 'artifacts/handshake-inline-rust.log').read_text()
suites = [int(value) for value in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed;', tests) if int(value)]
assert sum(suites) == 138 and 'test result: FAILED' not in tests
clippy = (root / 'artifacts/handshake-inline-clippy.log').read_text()
js = (root / 'artifacts/handshake-inline-js.log').read_text()
release = (root / 'artifacts/handshake-inline-release.log').read_text()
assert 'Finished' in clippy and 'warning:' not in clippy and 'Finished' in release
assert 'pass 6' in js and 'pass 1' in js and 'fail 0' in js
layouts = {name: (root / f'artifacts/handshake-layout-{name}.log').read_text()
           for name in ['before', 'inline-prototype', 'selected', 'release-selected']}
assert 'upgrade=288 websocket=320' in layouts['before'] and 'connection=512' in layouts['before']
assert 'boxed_stage=320 inline_stage=320 connection=512 boxed_align=8 inline_align=8' in layouts['release-selected']
checks = {'source_revision': revision, 'runtime_implementation_revision': meta['source_revision'],
          'rust': {'command': ['cargo', 'test', '--locked', '--all-targets'], 'passed': 138, 'suites': suites, 'exit_code': 0, 'output': tests},
          'clippy': {'exit_code': 0, 'output': clippy}, 'release': {'exit_code': 0, 'output': release},
          'javascript': {'passed': 7, 'exit_code': 0, 'output': js}, 'verification': verification,
          'layouts': layouts, 'small_checks': []}
for command in [['cargo', 'fmt', '--check'], ['python3', '-m', 'py_compile', 'scripts/handshake-pressure.py'], ['python3', 'scripts/check-vendor.py']]:
    done = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True); assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
    checks['small_checks'].append({'command': command, 'exit_code': 0, 'output': done.stdout + done.stderr})
(bench / '2026-10-16-handshake-inline-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(checks, indent=2) + '\n')

tracked = lambda *paths: subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', *paths], cwd=root, text=True).splitlines()
extra = [root / 'artifacts' / name for name in ['handshake-inline-study.py', 'handshake-inline-memory.py', 'handshake-inline-alloc-symbols.py',
    'handshake-inline-routing-guard.py', 'handshake-inline-burst-guard.py', 'handshake-inline-verify.py', 'handshake-inline-stability.py',
    'handshake-inline-api.py', 'refresh-handshake-inline-runtime.py', 'record-handshake-inline-browser.py', 'record-handshake-inline-checkpoint.py', 'paging-accept.mjs']]
with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:1339/metrics', timeout=3) as response:
    live_metrics = {key: int(value) for key, value in (line.split() for line in response.read().decode().splitlines() if line.startswith('war_'))}
empty(live_metrics)
queues = subprocess.check_output(['ss', '-H', '-ltn', 'sport = :1338'], text=True).splitlines()
assert len(queues) == 4 and all(int(row.split()[2]) == 1024 for row in queues)
evidence = [desc(path) for path in sorted(bench.glob('2026-10-16-handshake-*.json')) if path.name != '2026-10-16-handshake-inline-build.json']
record = {'passed': True, 'source_revision': revision, 'runtime_implementation_revision': meta['source_revision'], 'candidate': meta,
          'platform': platform.platform(), 'rustc': subprocess.check_output(['rustc', '--version'], text=True).strip(),
          'scope': 'Local Linux checkpoint. Inline upgrade metadata removes repeat state boxes at unchanged measured320-byte stage/512-byte connection. Four allocator diagnostics use original995d8c3 controller and replacement allocator;48 ordinary pending-header cases use paced30e747f driver, with18 standard/burst guards run sequentially without builds/profiles/faults/competing benchmark load. Throughput ranges overlap in all cohorts; requested allocation/live-metadata reduction is retained, without general speedup,latency orCPU-saving claim. Cold acceptance allocation, parser-buffer allocation, kernel memory, real malloc classes and production capacity are distinct. Original early drain fixture failed because it included the continuously active healthy socket and is not relay-failure evidence. Current runtime sources match browser acceptance; hosted CI/deployment unverified. Goal remains active.',
          'runtime_sources': [desc(root / name) for name in tracked('src', 'vendor', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock')],
          'helpers_and_tests': [desc(root / name) for name in tracked('scripts', 'examples', 'tests', 'clients/js', '.github/workflows/rust.yml')] + [desc(path) for path in extra],
          'documentation': [desc(root / name) for name in ['README.md', 'docs/STATUS.md', 'docs/operations.md', 'docs/performance.md', 'docs/stability.md']],
          'frozen_runtime': [desc(root / meta['directory'] / name) for name in meta['binaries']],
          'clients': [desc(root / meta['helper']['directory'] / 'admission'), desc(root / 'artifacts/baselines/fanout-probe/inspection'),
                      desc(root / 'artifacts/baselines/room-churn-client/inspection'), desc(root / 'artifacts/baselines/address-churn-client/stress')],
          'frozen_drivers': {key: [desc(root / meta[key]['directory'] / name) for name in meta[key]['sources']] for key in ['driver', 'allocator_driver']},
          'heap_captures': memory['captures'], 'evidence': evidence, 'range_overlap': overlap,
          'exploratory_harness_failure': {'explanation': 'Initial drain check included the healthy socket. Corrected peer-port filter used for all retained comparisons.', 'record': desc(root / 'artifacts/handshake-pressure-first.json')},
          'browser_screenshot': browser['screenshot'], 'browser_assets': browser['browser_assets'],
          'manual_services': json.loads((root / 'artifacts/reactor-manual-services.json').read_text()),
          'live_listener_rows': queues, 'live_metrics': live_metrics, 'collector_source': Path(__file__).read_text()}
(bench / '2026-10-16-handshake-inline-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'source': revision, 'runtime': meta['source_revision'], 'rust': 138, 'ordinary_cases': 66,
                  'runtime_sources': len(record['runtime_sources']), 'helpers_and_tests': len(record['helpers_and_tests']), 'evidence': len(evidence)}))
